declarations.name: AuiValidationMessage

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Message text. Empty hides the message and unlinks the target.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Visual tone and icon. Only 'error' sets aria-invalid on the target.

inputs.name: for
inputs.description: Control described by the message: receives the host id in aria-describedby while a message is shown, and aria-invalid for errors.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.signature: setMessage(message: string, tone?: ValidationMessageTone | undefined): void
methods.description: Set the message and optionally the tone.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Hide the message and unlink the target.

accessibility.pattern: Field description referenced by aria-describedby, with aria-invalid on the target for errors (HTML/ARIA).

limitations: Not a live region: a new message is read when the user moves to the target (through aria-describedby), not when it appears.
Every update re-creates the icon element.
No locale option: the message text is consumer-provided.
